midi.title: MIDI and instruments
midi.intro: The instrument the music skills play on: the device's own synthesizer, FluidSynth with real instrument samples, or an instrument plugged into the device. Keyboards plugged in can be played along to.
midi.now.title: Right now
midi.settings.title: Settings
midi.synth.port: An instrument on a MIDI port
midi.listen: Listen to keyboards plugged into the device
midi.thru: Play what a keyboard plays on the device's own sound
midi.duck: Turn the music down while the assistant speaks or listens
midi.soundfont: SoundFont for FluidSynth (a .sf2 file; empty: the usual places)
midi.noPorts: MIDI ports need python-rtmidi: pip install "ovos-phal-plugin-midi[ports]"
midi.noFluid: FluidSynth is not installed: pip install "ovos-phal-plugin-midi[fluidsynth]" and a SoundFont (fluid-soundfont-gm).
midi.saved: Saved. The instrument plays with the new settings.
midi.restart: Saved. Restart OVOS' PHAL service for the plugin to use it.
midi.error: The MIDI plugin could not be asked.
